subject: Marketplace listing inquiry: demo request from CloudSight
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudsight.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: support@marketplace.example
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Marketplace listing — interested in a short intro & demo

Hi Kimberly,

We came across Redwood on the Azure Marketplace and I signed up for a trial this morning. My name is Elena, Head of Platform at CloudSight — we're evaluating hosted inference options for our vision pipeline and your marketplace listing looked promising.

Would love a 30-minute intro and a demo focused on:
- Typical latency and cost for real-time image captioning workloads
- Options for private deployment (VPC/on-prem) and SSO/KMS
- Any relevant compliance docs (SOC2, data residency)

Our team is in Rome (CET). Are there slots this week or early next? Happy to coordinate.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform | CloudSight
elena@cloudsight.ai
[Attachment: CloudSight-brief.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

--
Forwarded to Azure Marketplace support for FYI: please confirm any marketplace trial metadata we should share.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudsight.ai>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:37:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — interested in a short intro & demo

Hi Elena — thanks for reaching out and welcome!

I looped in Aditya (SDR) to get a short intake and lock a time that works for your CET-based team. Marcus (AE) will run the demo and Laura from CS can join for any onboarding/compliance questions.

Aditya — could you propose 2-3 CET-friendly 30-minute slots? Also Elena — quick question: is your priority hosted API to start or are you already leaning toward a private deployment?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Growth | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood-quick-link.txt (link to marketplace listing)]

Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 10:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — interested in a short intro & demo

Hi Elena — great to meet you! I'm Aditya on the SDR team. Thanks for the context.

I have the following CET slots open:
- Thu Jan 7, 11:00–11:30 CET
- Fri Jan 8, 09:30–10:00 CET
- Mon Jan 11, 14:00–14:30 CET

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows that do and I'll coordinate.

Quick note on your questions: we can demo hosted API capabilities by default; we also cover private deployment options. For SOC 2 and data residency, I'll attach the one-pager and we can route detailed docs to Laura.

Here is a one-click scheduler if helpful: https://cal.redwood.com/slots/aditya-30min?tz=Europe%2FRome

Thanks — I can send a calendar invite once you pick a slot.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood-OnePager.pdf (PDF, 340KB)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudsight.ai>

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — interested in a short intro & demo

Hi Aditya / Kimberly — thanks for the quick replies.

Mon Jan 11 14:00–14:30 CET works well for our team. Please note we'll have three folks on the call: myself (Platform), Marco (Backend Engineer), and Sofia (Security/Compliance).

A couple items to flag for the demo:
- Can Marcus cover typical per-token cost estimates vs batching/quantization strategies?
- We need to understand SSO (SAML) and KMS integrations for private deployments.
- If possible, please include a short snippet on how the runtime handles KV cache / streaming for low-latency inference.

Also, can you confirm whether data from our trial is automatically shared with the marketplace? We prefer minimal metadata sharing.

Thanks,
Elena

We'll cover:
- Cost/latency tradeoffs and example numbers for vision workloads (including batching & quantization impacts)
- Short walkthrough of private deployment options, SSO (SAML) and KMS flows
- KV cache and streaming examples (live demo + code snippet)
